signature.name: VTask.IsOrthogonal
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {R : Type u_2} -> {M : Type u_3} -> {N : Type u_4} -> [CommRing R] -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> [AddCommGroup N] -> [Module R N] -> (P : RootPairing ι R M N) -> (i j : ι) -> Prop

conventions.statement: VTask.IsOrthogonal P i j requires BOTH pairing P i j = 0 AND pairing P j i = 0; neither condition alone is sufficient in general.
conventions.note: The pairing in a root pairing is not assumed symmetric, so both directions must be checked.

conventions.statement: VTask.IsOrthogonal P i j holds if and only if VTask.IsOrthogonal P j i holds; the relation is symmetric in i and j.
conventions.note: Follows directly from the conjunction structure by swapping the two conjuncts.

conventions.statement: Under [NeZero (2 : R)], [IsDomain R], and [Module.IsTorsionFree R M], one pairing vanishing implies the other, so VTask.IsOrthogonal P i j ↔ pairing P i j = 0.
conventions.note: Without these hypotheses the two conditions are independent.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) (i j : ι), VTask.IsOrthogonal P i j ↔ VTask.IsOrthogonal P j i

facts.statement: ∀ {ι R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) (i j : ι), VTask.IsOrthogonal P i j → VTask.IsOrthogonal P j i
